name: Reasoning models via BYOM
summary: BYOM-routed o3 / o4-mini call with reasoning_effort and max_completion_tokens forwarded.
description: Reasoning model calls use `aoai.responses.create(model='{connection}/{deployment}', reasoning={...}, max_output_tokens=...)` or equivalent SDK fields to pass reasoning-specific parameters through APIM. This ensures users can route o-series or reasoning-capable deployments through the gateway without policies stripping required request fields.
notes:
Verified end-to-end for a BYOM-routed reasoning model with reasoning-specific parameters forwarded through APIM. See `test.py`.

The probe uses `REASONING_MODEL` when configured; APIM policies that strip unknown body fields can silently break `reasoning_effort` / reasoning settings or token-limit fields. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/openai/how-to/reasoning.
